STEP 9. Check the power window sub switch ground 
circuit at power window sub switch connector E-05.
(1) Disconnect power window sub switch connector E-05 and 
measure at the harness side.
(2) Measure the resistance between terminal 2 and ground.
Q: Is the resistance less than 2 ohms?
YES : Go to Step 12.
NO : Go to Step 10.
STEP 10. Check power window sub switch connector E-05 
and ETACS-ECU connector C-112 for damage.
Q: Is power window sub switch connector E-05 in good 
condition?
YES : Go to Step 11.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The door lock switch 
input signal should be able to be checked and the 
central door locking system should work normally.
